description: A Dart source file defining the ReadArticleScreen widget in a Flutter application. It manages displaying a news article within a WebView, and includes functionalities for text-to-speech (TTS) reading, sharing, saving, and browsing news articles. It also includes UI components such as an AppBar with menu options and TTS controls.

classes.name: ReadArticleArgs
classes.description: A simple data class holding the NewsArticle object passed as arguments to the ReadArticleScreen.

classes.name: ReadArticleScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the screen to read a news article, including WebView display and TTS features.

classes.name: _ReadArticleScreenState
classes.description: State class for ReadArticleScreen, managing WebView, TTS, and UI interactions.

classes.name: _ListenMenuButton
classes.description: A StatelessWidget representing a popup menu button with options to control TTS playback, speed, and voice.

methods.name: _configureTts
methods.description: Configures the TTS engine with language and speech rate.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI Scaffold with AppBar and WebView widget.

methods.name: _handleMoreAction
methods.description: Handles actions from the 'More' menu: sharing, saving, browsing.

methods.name: _ttsText
methods.description: Generates the text to be read by TTS, appending a paywall message.

methods.name: _play
methods.description: Initiates speech synthesis of article content.

methods.name: _applyRateAndPlay
methods.description: Applies speech rate and starts TTS playback.

methods.name: _applyVoiceAndPlay
methods.description: Sets the desired voice for TTS and then plays.
